name: Josou Gakuen
source:
In a distant future, women are few, as the birth rates of women have significantly declined. To defeat the low birth rates, the Japanese government secretly initiates the "cross dressers pregnancy project." The project aims to make cross dressers who have suitable potential to form couples and make them get pregnant by mandatory law.

The protagonist Nogi is informed by his teacher Yomoda Sakae he'll be participating in this breeding project with himself (Yomoda), his junior BL lover Chiharu, and his popular classmate/rival Rei. Initially Nogi is completely against the idea of being together with a man but is soon left without a choice...
